cards.text: Jesus is in the temple courts, teaching the people (John 8:2). Once again He speaks to them: "I am the light of the world." Friend, after YEARS in the back of a junk drawer, when somebody says light, I'm LISTENING.

cards.question: Jesus says He is the light of the world. What does He promise whoever follows Him?

answers.text: They will never walk in the darkness
They will never be hungry again
They will never be troubled again

cards.text: Jesus also says whoever follows Him "…will have the light of life." Then the Pharisees, a group of strict religious leaders, push back with their reason READY, like they rehearsed it in the car on the way over.

cards.question: What's the Pharisees' complaint about what Jesus just said?

answers.text: He is teaching on the Sabbath
He never studied with a teacher

cards.question: Jesus agrees with the Pharisees that His testimony about Himself is not valid.

cards.text: Jesus says His testimony IS valid, because He knows where He came from and where He's going, but they don't know either one. Friend, I've walked into my own storeroom and forgotten why I came in.
Then Jesus tells them they judge according to the flesh, and as for Him, He judges no one. Meanwhile, I judge every batch that comes out of my oven, and not one has EVER won its case.

cards.question: Jesus says that even if He does judge, His judgment is true, because He is not alone. He is with the ___ who sent Him.

cards.text: Now Jesus goes right to their own Law. Friend, nothing ends an argument faster than somebody reading your OWN group chat back to you.

cards.question: Jesus says that even in their own Law it is written that the testimony of ___ men is valid.

cards.text: Then Jesus says He testifies about Himself, and the Father who sent Him testifies about Him too.

cards.question: When they ask, "Where is Your Father?", Jesus answers that if they knew Him, they would know His Father as well.

cards.text: Jesus says all this while teaching in the temple courts, near the treasury, right out in the open. And still, nobody lays a hand on Him.

cards.question: Jesus is teaching right out in the open. Why does no one seize Him?

answers.text: His hour had not yet come
The guards are afraid of Him

cards.text: Again Jesus tells them He's going away, and they'll look for Him, but they will die in their sin. That's a heavy word, friend.

cards.question: Jesus is going away. Where He is going, He says, they ___ come.

cards.text: That line leaves the Jews asking whether He will kill Himself, since He says they can't come where He's going.
Then He tells them, "You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world."

cards.question: Jesus says they will die in their sins unless they believe something. Finish His words: "Unless you believe…"

answers.text: That I am John the Baptist

cards.question: When they ask Jesus, "Who are You?", He tells them something brand new.

cards.text: Jesus says He has much to say about them and much to judge, but the One who sent Him is truthful, and what Jesus has heard from Him, He tells the world. Friend, I can't pass a message across my own bakery without it coming out WRONG by the end.

cards.question: As Jesus talks about the One who sent Him, the people listening don't understand that He's telling them about the Father.

cards.text: So Jesus says, "When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am He…" Son of Man is the name Jesus uses for Himself (Mark 2:10).

cards.question: Jesus says that once they've lifted up the Son of Man, they'll know something about how He speaks and acts. What is it?

answers.text: He does nothing on His own
He learned it all from the scribes
He speaks only to His followers

cards.text: Jesus says the One who sent Him is with Him and has not left Him alone. After my years forgotten in the back of a junk drawer, friend, that line hits me right in the apron.

cards.question: Jesus says the One who sent Him hasn't left Him alone, because He always does what ___ Him.
Jesus keeps speaking about the Father who sent Him. As He speaks these things, what do many do?

cards.text: And that's where we pull this batch out of the oven, friend. But keep that apron ON, because this conversation is NOT finished.
